title: Umbel workspace backup manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of a directory workspace-backup writes (D214): every file the host keeps in state/ but its key files, each with its kind, size and SHA-256, and each key file named with what is lost without it. workspace-restore reads it.

sha256.description: umbel.toml as the backup was taken; it is not copied

spaces.description: The declared spaces whose stores are in the backup, under spaces/<space>/ as a store backup lays them out

path.description: Relative to the backup directory: state/<path> goes back to the same path in the workspace, spaces/<space>/<file> to that space's stores

kind.description: journal, pending, events and cursors are copied as one cut under the workspace lock; shared, usage and every *.sqlite3 file with VACUUM INTO; store, memory and index as store-backup copies a space

keys.description: Every key file in state/keys/ and each space's memory.keys: never copied

effect.description: What is lost when the key file is

derived.description: What a backup leaves out because the host rebuilds it
